User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the Kalyan Winner application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the user entity.

email.description: The email address of the user.

registrationDate.description: The date and time the user registered.

Wallet.title: Wallet
Wallet.description: Represents a user's wallet within the Kalyan Winner application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the wallet entity.

balance.description: The current balance of the wallet.

Transaction.title: Transaction
Transaction.description: Represents a transaction within the Kalyan Winner application.

id.description: Unique identifier for the transaction entity.

transactionDate.description: The date and time of the transaction.

transactionType.description: The type of the transaction (e.g., deposit, withdrawal, bet placement, winnings).

id.description: Unique identifier for the Kalyan Result entity.

resultDate.description: The date of the Kalyan Matka result.

resultValue.description: The actual result value of the Kalyan Matka game.

Bet.title: Bet
Bet.description: Represents a user's bet on a Kalyan Matka game.

id.description: Unique identifier for the bet entity.

betValue.description: The number the user placed the bet on.

betDate.description: The date and time the bet was placed.

definition.description: Stores user profiles. Path-based ownership, where `userId` matches `request.auth.uid`.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the user.

definition.description: Stores user's wallet information. Path-based ownership; only the user can access their own wallet. The `userId` field in wallet document must match the document ID and `request.auth.uid`.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the user.

definition.description: Stores transactions related to a specific wallet. Path-based ownership, inherited from the wallet. Only the user owning the wallet can access the transactions. `userId` and `walletId` link back to their respective documents.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the user.

params.name: transactionId
params.description: The unique identifier of the transaction.

definition.description: Stores Kalyan Matka results.  Accessible to all users for read operations. Write access restricted to admins (via a separate `/roles_admin/{uid}` collection check).

params.name: kalyanResultId
params.description: The unique identifier of the Kalyan result.

definition.description: Stores user's bets on Kalyan Matka games. Path-based ownership; only the user can access their own bets. `userId` in the bet document must match the document ID and `request.auth.uid`.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the user.

params.name: betId
params.description: The unique identifier of the bet.

definition.description: A collection to store the user IDs of administrators. Existence in this collection grants admin privileges. No data is stored within the documents; existence is the only factor.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier of the user that is an admin.

firestore.reasoning:
The Firestore data structure is designed to support the Kalyan Winner application, focusing on user management, wallet functionality, game results, and bet placements. The structure emphasizes authorization independence and efficient data retrieval while adhering to the design principles of clarity, security, and scalability.

**Authorization Independence:**
Authorization is primarily based on path-based ownership (for user-related data) and membership maps (if collaborative features are added in the future). For instance, User wallets are stored under `/users/{userId}/wallet`, directly linking the wallet to the user, thus requiring no `get()` calls to parent documents for authorization. Bets also follow this pattern.

**QAPs (Rules are not Filters):**
The structure supports secure `list` operations by segregating data based on access requirements.  User-specific data (wallets, bets) resides under the `/users/{userId}` path, allowing listing bets and wallets with rules based on `request.auth.uid == userId`.  Kalyan results are stored in a separate collection, enabling listing of all results. There is no need to filter results based on user-specific criteria, as the bets, not results, are linked to users.

**Denormalization:**
While not explicitly denormalizing membership maps in this basic structure, future extensions involving collaborative betting or shared wallets could utilize membership maps denormalized into bet documents to grant access based on team membership, if needed.
